about: Curated texts for sentences a word swap cannot fix (see docs/branding.md). Each entry is
app id -> the exact English source text (the translation key) -> the text people see instead.
"english" is used for en and en_GB (and other English variants); "every_language" is used for every
language, for upstream notices that speak as the upstream project; "by_language" is language code ->
app id -> key -> text, for one language whose translation leaves the name out where our name belongs
